title.en: A family of readings within what it reads

statement.en: Over inhabited types with values' equality decided, some family of readings indexed by what it reads is complete exactly where nothing differs; where a map moves every value, completing it is an unfolding incomplete at every step, not returning, held by no finite stock; the liar has no still value.
statement.zh: 在类型非空、值的相等可判定时，某个以所读者为索引的读法族恰在没有差别处完备；映射移动每个值时，补全它是每一步都不完备、从不返回、不被有限储存持有的展开；说谎者没有静值。

laws.en: For any family ψ : A → A → B of readings indexed by what it reads and any likeness of values, a member says a reading g where its value is alike with g's at every argument, and the gap of a map f is x ↦ f (ψ x x). Where f moves every value, none alike with its image, no member says the gap.
laws.zh: 对以所读者为索引的任意读法族 ψ : A → A → B 与值的任意相同关系：某成员说出读法 g，是指它在每个自变量上的值与 g 的相同；映射 f 的缺口是 x ↦ f (ψ x x)。f 移动每个值、没有值与其像相同时，没有成员说出缺口。

laws.en: A family saying every reading gives every map f some value b alike with f b; with likeness transitive, a member saying g says every reading alike with g at each argument.
laws.zh: 说出每个读法的族给每个映射 f 一个与 f b 相同的值 b；相同关系可传递时，说出 g 的成员说出每个逐点与 g 相同的读法。

laws.en: No claim is equivalent to its negation, so no family of claims indexed by what it reads says every reading, none saying x ↦ ¬ ψ x x, and no frame whose claims are its own configurations realizes with them every pattern of claims about them.
laws.zh: 没有主张与其否定等价，故没有以所读者为索引的主张族说出每个读法，没有一个说出 x ↦ ¬ ψ x x；主张即其自身构形的框架，不能以这些构形实现关于它们的每种主张模式。

laws.en: For values compared by equality: a family saying every reading makes every value equal to b where equality with b is decided; where all values are equal and A and B have elements, some family says every reading; with equality of values decided and A and B inhabited, some family says every reading exactly where all values are equal.
laws.zh: 对以相等比较的值：与 b 的相等可判定时，说出每个读法的族使每个值等于 b；值都相等且 A 与 B 有元素时，有族说出每个读法；值的相等可判定、A 与 B 非空时，有族说出每个读法，恰当值都相等。

laws.en: A sequence of families unfolds under f where each step keeps every reading said before and the next step says the step's gap. Where f moves every value, every step of an unfolding misses its own gap, and no step m says the gap of any step m + k.
laws.zh: 一列族在 f 下展开，是指每一步保留此前说出的每个读法，并在下一步说出该步的缺口。f 移动每个值时，展开的每一步都缺其自身的缺口，第 m 步不说出任何第 m + k 步的缺口。

laws.en: Where f moves every value, in an unfolding under f: with likeness transitive, the gap of step m is not alike at every argument with that of any step m + 1 + k; and not everything step n + 1 + k says is said at step n, so it never returns.
laws.zh: f 移动每个值时，在 f 下的展开中：相同关系可传递时，第 m 步的缺口不在每个自变量上与任何第 m + 1 + k 步的缺口相同；第 n + 1 + k 步所说的并非都在第 n 步说过，故它从不返回。

laws.en: With likeness symmetric and transitive, for every L, pairwise different readings are not all alike with members of a stock of L readings, with no decision on the values; so where f moves every value, no finite stock holds every gap of an unfolding under f.
laws.zh: 相同关系对称且可传递时，对每个 L，两两不同的读法不都与 L 个读法的储存中的成员相同，不对值作判定；故 f 移动每个值时，没有有限储存持有 f 下展开的每个缺口。

laws.en: On Bool with negation, which moves every value, the sequence unfolding unfolds: every step misses its own gap, not everything a later step says is said at an earlier one, and no stock of L readings holds every gap, for every L.
laws.zh: 在 Bool 上以移动每个值的否定，序列 unfolding 展开：每一步缺其自身的缺口，较晚一步所说的并非都在较早一步说过，对每个 L，L 个读法的储存不持有每个缺口。

laws.en: Revising a value by a map that moves every value under equality changes it at every step of its orbit; revising a claim by negation changes it at every step up to equivalence; the two-valued negation returns to its start along its orbit.
laws.zh: 以在相等下移动每个值的映射修正一个值，其轨道每一步都改变它；以否定修正一个主张，在等价意义下每一步都改变；二值的否定沿其轨道回到起点。

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：gap_unsaid、claims_incomplete、Unfolds 的各条与节律对每个族、每个值的类型与每个“相同”成立。
hypotheses.en: No premise: gap_unsaid, claims_incomplete, the laws of Unfolds and the rhythm hold for every family, type of values and likeness.

hypotheses.zh: 局部条件写在定理之中：alike_of_complete 要与一个值的相等可判定，complete_iff_alike 要值的相等可判定，gaps_differ 要 same 可传递，stock_unheld 要它对称、可传递（只在自然数下标上判定）。
hypotheses.en: Local conditions are written into the theorems: alike_of_complete needs equality with one value decided, complete_iff_alike needs equality of values decidable, gaps_differ needs same transitive, stock_unheld needs it symmetric and transitive (deciding only on natural-number indices).

hypotheses.zh: 读法族以所读者为索引，这是给出的读法；算术编码与可证性没有陈述。
hypotheses.en: The readings form a family indexed by what they read, a supplied reading; arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.

does_not_show.en: Gödel's incompleteness and the halting problem lie outside its laws: arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.
does_not_show.zh: 哥德尔的不完备与停机问题在其规律之外：算术编码与可证性没有陈述。

does_not_show.en: Completeness exactly where nothing differs is for values compared by decided equality; for claims the laws give incompleteness only.
does_not_show.zh: “恰在没有差别处完备”只对以可判定相等比较的值；对主张，规律只给出不完备。

does_not_show.en: The rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only; for any other map moving every value, only that revision never rests.
does_not_show.zh: 节律只对二值否定被证明是周期的；对其他移动每个值的映射，只证明修正从不停息。

detail.zh: Bool 上的展开（unfolding_open）：每一步都不完备，从不返回，没有有限储存持有其缺口；二值否定的修正从不停息（revision_never_rests、flip_moves）。
detail.en: The unfolding on Bool (unfolding_open): incomplete at every step, never returning, its gaps held by no finite stock; revising the two-valued negation never rests (revision_never_rests, flip_moves).

next_delta.en: Prove the instance theorems connecting these laws to the periphery's RootCoverageBoundary and to Learning's diagonal, where no extrapolation rests on every course.
next_delta.zh: 证明把这些规律接到外围 RootCoverageBoundary 与 Learning 之对角线（没有外推在每个历程上停息）的实例定理。

correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“push the frontier, as far as possible”。外围 RootCoverageBoundary（数学抽象，CoverageBoundary.lean，导入 Std）有同一对角线的函数与谓词形式（fixed_point_of_complete、diagonal_extension_strict）；这里在核心中不用公理重述，并加上完备恰在没有差别处、补全的展开与节律。检验 Ren 的推测中“从内部”的一半：任何给定的真可以在下一步说出，不能从一个情境全部说出，限制在投影。由 revision_never_rests 读出否定的两个状态（Negation.two_states）。读法（AI 的读法）：庄子的“一与言为二，二与一为三”有 Unfolds 的回退形式；宣布进循环的自我预测没有停息的对；早先把道可道读作“说不尽”是 AI 的读法，不是 Ren 的。
correspondence.en: Following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026. The periphery's RootCoverageBoundary (mathematical abstraction, CoverageBoundary.lean, importing Std) has the function and predicate forms of the same diagonal (fixed_point_of_complete, diagonal_extension_strict); here it is restated in the core with no axiom, with completeness exactly where nothing differs, the completing unfolding and the rhythm added. It tests the “from within” half of Ren's speculation: any given truth can be said at the next step, not all from one situation, and the limit is the projection's. The negation's two states are read off revision_never_rests (Negation.two_states). Readings (AI readings): Zhuangzi's 一与言为二，二与一为三 has the regress form of Unfolds; a self-prediction announced into its loop has no still right value; the earlier reading of 道可道 as “说不尽” was the AI's, not Ren's.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.orbit、Law.Returns 与 gap_of_lt：修正是轨道，否定的返回是 Returns；补全的展开像保留的历史一样从不返回。
detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, Law.Returns and gap_of_lt: revision is an orbit and the negation's return is Returns; the completing unfolding, like a kept history, never returns.

detail.zh: 从同一节律读出否定恰有两个状态。
detail.en: The negation's exactly two states are read off the same rhythm.

detail.zh: 另一种投影的限制：不依语境的值；这里是从内部持有每个读法。
detail.en: Another limit of projection: context-free values; here, holding every reading from within.

detail.zh: 它的 diagonal_misses 与 diagonal_unrested 是外推的形式，与 gap_unsaid、revision_never_rests 同形而对象不同，各自写成。
detail.en: Its diagonal_misses and diagonal_unrested are the extrapolation's form, of the same form as gap_unsaid and revision_never_rests and a different object, written independently.
